summary: Examined the one supporting mechanism the account had not touched — read-request completion when leadership changes — and recorded a sourced answer that is explicitly not a defect. A MsgReadIndex is queued only by a leader that has not yet committed in its own term (raft.go 1361-1368); it is drained only by releasePendingReadIndexMessages (raft.go 2127-2143), which requires committedEntryInCurrentTerm and is called from exactly one site, the leader's append-response commit path (raft.go 1548-1556); and a search for the field finds no writer on any leadership-change path (declared at raft.go 428-435, no other occurrences). So a queued request is never cancelled: it is answered only if that same node becomes leader again and commits in the new term — with the commit index at release time, so a late answer is not stale — and otherwise stays unanswered, which the snapshot's own ReadIndex documentation permits (

, node.go 218-224). Recorded as a Behavior with conditions, a child investigation and an explained account with defect_claim null, flagging the residual difference from votes and appends (which the protocol itself retries). Source reading only, no execution claimed; five new source ranges were recorded.
